title: SWF FrameLabel & ExportAssets tags
description: Extend SWF compiler to emit FrameLabel (tag 43) for keyframes with non-empty frame.label, and ExportAssets (tag 56) for Symbol library items with exportForActionScript=true (includes linkageIdentifier). Both purely in packages/swf/. FrameLabel: UI8[] null-terminated string. ExportAssets: UI16 count + (UI16 charId + string name) per export. See docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
